events.title: Leaping Dungeon - Official Trailer
events.summary: Ribbit frogs! Checkout the Official Trailer for Leaping Dungeon!This marks one year of development and in one month Leaping Dungeon will join the October Steam Next Fest. I can't express enough how happy I am for all the support and kind words I've gotten.Thanks to everyone who joined the playtest and helped me improve the game. A big shoutout to the couple of frogs who playtested Leaping Dungeon a lot, you made this experience so much more rewarding. 🐸 I hope you are as excited as I am to play

events.title: Join the Playtest
events.summary: Ribbit frogs! 🐸 I wanted to do a quick update and share that you can now signup to the playtest!What weapons will you choose? A flyswatter, a brick, a tongue? Or why not use them all at once to face the swarm! 🦟Challenge bosses, watch out for exploding shrooms, and hunt down the Fly Lord. Share your feedback and suggestions. Report any unwanted bugs you encounter.ThanksTiny Frog Games

events.title: Welcome to Leaping Dungeon!
events.summary: Hi frogs, Thanks for checking out Leaping Dungeon! Happy frog! 🐸Next up I'm working towards a playtest. If you have cool ideas you think I should add then let me know and I'll try to add that before the playtest. If you want to help me out, the best way you can do that is to wishlist Leaping Dungeon. ^^Launching the steam page and the announcement trailer was a really exiting moment and I'm beyond happy with all your kind words.How would you like to keep in touch, Discussions or Discord server?
